title: Dapper Man with Straw Boater Hat, 1923 Sepia Vintage Photo
description: A well-composed portrait of a gentleman in full 1920s summer attire, posed leaning against a grand stone porch entry. He wears spectacles, a dark suit jacket, light-colored striped trousers, two-tone spectator or saddle shoes, and holds a classic straw boater hat in his hand. The reverse of the photo is inscribed with the date September 16, 1923, offering a clear temporal anchor into Roaring Twenties American fashion and domestic architecture.
